newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express financial officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express financial officer resigns.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Friday that Roland Breunig, vice president and chief financial officer, left the company to pursue other opportunities.
The company said Breunig's departure was "in no way related" to its financial performance.
"We continue our plan for steady and profitable growth and our performance in 1996 remains strong," Timothy Hoeksema, chairman, said in a statement.
Robert Bahlman, controller, will act as chief financial officer until a permanent replacement is named, Midwest Express added.
